meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: Claude 改为通过 agent-browser 命令行操作浏览器:打开网址、按元素引用点击或填表、截图存 PDF、录屏。页面跳转或结构变化后要重新快照再继续。
howto.when: 当你需要打开网页、与页面交互(填表、点击等)、或截图抓取信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 的表单页,填好邮箱和密码后点提交
say.note: 它会先快照页面,再按元素引用操作

say.text: 截一张整页截图,保存成 full.png
对比这两个网址的页面有什么差异
say.note: 支持 URL、快照、截图三种对比方式

howto.what_en: Claude drives a browser through the agent-browser CLI: open URLs, click or fill elements by ref, take screenshots and PDFs, record video. After navigation or DOM changes it re-snapshots the page before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to open a website, interact with a page (filling forms, clicking), or screenshot and extract page info.

say_en.text: Open example.com's form page, fill in email and password, then submit
say_en.note: It snapshots first, then acts on element refs

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot and save it as full.png
Compare the pages of these two URLs and show the differences
say_en.note: Supports URL, snapshot, and screenshot diffs
